vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Maintain accurate fixture and venue notices, including postponements and cancellations.
requirements.zh: 维护准确的赛程及场地通知，包括延期与取消。

requirements.en: Coordinate availability and follow up on communication with teams and match officials.
requirements.zh: 协调可用时间，并跟进与球队及赛事裁判人员的沟通。

requirements.en: Independently construct and approve a full-season pitch allocation that resolves team and venue constraints.
requirements.zh: 独立编制并批准解决球队与场地限制的完整赛季球场安排。
